# Witty Yeti

> Anonymous prank products shipped to whoever deserves it.

Witty Yeti is a prank e-commerce store based in Charlotte, NC. We sell anonymous prank mail, prank boxes, bad parking revenge cards, and prank stickers. Every prank ships with free shipping, a lifetime satisfaction guarantee, and complete sender anonymity.

## What We Sell

### Prank Mail Tubes (Best Sellers)
Embarrassing mailing tubes with outrageous URLs printed in large text on the outside. Shipped anonymously via USPS — the mail carrier reads it, the neighbors see it, and the recipient has no idea who sent it. Available in three tiers: Base (standard delivery), Sign For It (requires in-person signature), and Confetti Bomb (explodes with confetti on opening).

Products: MicroPenisCure.com, BigAssDildos.com, VaginalOdorHelper.com, BulkCondomDelivery.com

### Prank Boxes
Realistic fake product boxes that make real gifts look absurd. The gift goes inside the prank box — the recipient opens what looks like a bizarre product only to find a normal gift inside.

Products: Human Cone, Child Chucker, Box in a Box (18 nested boxes)

### Bad Parking Cards
Leave-behind cards and bumper stickers for terrible parkers. Professionally printed, weatherproof, designed to look official.

Products: Fake Parking Tickets, Hit & Run Edition, Road Rage Edition, Street Justice Edition, I Park Like An Ass bumper stickers, Parked Like A Moron notes

### Prank Stickers
Realistic stickers designed to confuse, embarrass, or delight. Includes fake WiFi QR codes, voice-activated signs, fake electrical outlets, and more.

Products: Fake WiFi QR Stickers, Voice Activated Stickers, Fake Outlet Stickers, For Rectal Use Only, Adult Postcards, Fecal Sample, Machinery Warning, bumper stickers, combo packs
